subject.title: feat(ios): Liquid Glass UI, Action Button & Dynamic Island

question: Should OpenClaw accept a native iOS Action Button/App Intent that toggles Talk Mode as a core app feature now, or defer it to the broader Siri/App Intent direction tracked at https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/47584?
rationale: The remaining unique value is a new iOS platform capability rather than a bug fix, and current main has already superseded much of the branch's Liquid Glass and Live Activity implementation.

options.title: Sponsor a narrow current-main rebase
options.body: Accept the Action Button-to-Talk direction, but require the branch to be rebuilt on `RootTabs` while preserving current Live Activity and typography contracts.

options.title: Defer to the broader Siri issue
options.body: Close or pause this branch and handle native Siri/App Intent capability through https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/47584 after product and security review.

options.title: Accept the broader branch risk
options.body: Let the contributor continue this large branch, with explicit iOS owner review for stale shell, ActivityKit state, and proof gaps before merge.

recommendation.title: Sponsor a narrow current-main rebase
recommendation.body: Accept the Action Button-to-Talk direction, but require the branch to be rebuilt on `RootTabs` while preserving current Live Activity and typography contracts.

likelyOwner.reason: The current-main iOS Liquid Glass redesign and app-shell direction most directly affect whether this feature belongs in core now.
